title: A non-North-American number cannot be entered, and the question cannot be skipped
method: wizard drive with a UK number
observed_at_discovery: a_phone('+44 20 7946 0958') returns "That doesn't look like a 10-digit phone number"; the phone question is required with no skip, so the wizard re-asks forever and setup can never complete. norm_phone would also prefix +1 to a foreign number. Not this household's case -- a Wyoming landline is fine -- which is why it is filed low.
